description: Puts ONE of Paletoo’s effects on a design at an intensity (0–100; 0 takes it off): on what the person named (adjust_design’s target: «the headline», «the photo on slide 2», an id) or the whole artboard (target { role: «background» }, or none for a whole-artboard effect). Effects: soft-shadow, hard-shadow, long-shadow, inner-shadow, text-ring, outline, gradient, radial-gradient, sunset-gradient, glow, neon, blur, motion-blur, grain, halftone, riso-print, newsprint-dots, duotone, glitch, pixel, pixel-art, ascii, ascii-block, inner-glow, halo, distress, paper, emboss, echo, cutout, mosaic, stencil, dither, crt, black-and-white, vintage, vivid, vignette; blend modes (blend-multiply, blend-screen, blend-overlay…); or a look (risograph, duotone-poster, y2k-chrome… — built by the person’s open editor, so the design must be open). What each looks like: describe_catalogue { what: "effects" } (or paletoo://guide/effects). The person’s own word works too («зерно плівки», «cień»). A new effect of a kind replaces the old one. Live in the open editor (one undo step), else a new version. Example: { design, effect: «neon», intensity: 70, target: { role: «headline» } }. «text-ring» (words orbiting the person in 3D, a seamless loop) takes `text_ring`.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

effect.description: an effect id from the list above, or the person’s own word for it; e.g. «grain»

intensity.description: how strong, 0–100 (default 60; 0 takes the effect off)

say.description: optional: what your cursor says in the editor, in the person’s language; e.g. «Додаю зерно»

target.description: what it goes on, as adjust_design names things; none: the headline for a text effect, else the whole artboard. Several matches without all: true → a question back, nothing changed; e.g. { "role": "photo", "slide": 2 }

id.description: a layer or group id from describe_design

nth.description: in reading order, or by size

role.description: text = any, background = the slide’s colour, everything = all on it

text.description: words written in it; e.g. «Grand opening»

where.description: where it is now on its slide

words.description: the person’s own words for it (en / uk / pl); e.g. «заголовок на другому слайді»

text_ring.description: with «text-ring», all optional: preset (ring, double, behind = two bands behind the photo’s person, sale); radius_em; tilt° (8–18 reads best); lean°; bands (one per text line); back (mirror, dim, hide); separator; spin °/s; drift em; loop_s; behind (true or a photo id: the far half behind the person); e.g. { "preset": "behind", "bands": 2, "behind": true }

name: apply_effect
title: Apply an effect
